description: 한국해양교통안전공단_항만건설작업선 [ports and harbours] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국해양교통안전공단. 한국해양교통안전공단은 항만에서 수행되는 건설작업 과정에 투입되는 항만건설작업선 정보를 국민과 산업계에 제공하기 위하여 본 데이터를 개방한다. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
